_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante: gross bookings = signal de demande #1, puis revenu total, segments B2C/B2B/trivago, services lodging.

kpis.signal: KPI #1 secteur OTA. Re-acceleration post-COVID complete, recordhigh 2025. Capte volume de transactions intermedies
kpis.description_fr: Valeur totale des reservations brutes (lodging + air + autres). Indicateur de demande clef secteur Online Travel Agency. Revenue margin ~12% applique dessus.
kpis.description_en: Total gross bookings value (lodging + air + other). Key OTA demand indicator. ~12% revenue margin applied on top.

kpis.signal: Croissance soutenue +8%/an, portee par B2B et lodging. Niveau structurellement superieur a pre-COVID
kpis.description_fr: Revenu net Expedia Group apres prise en compte revenue margin. 80% lodging, 5% advertising. Net revenue (apres remboursements).
kpis.description_en: Expedia Group net revenue after revenue margin. 80% lodging, 5% advertising. Net revenue (post-refunds).

kpis.signal: Segment historique (Brand Expedia + Hotels.com + Vrbo). Croissance modeste face B2B. ~64% du CA total
kpis.description_fr: Segment Business-to-Consumer: Brand Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo. Coeur historique du groupe. Programme One Key fidelite unifie.
kpis.description_en: Business-to-Consumer segment: Brand Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo. Historical core. One Key unified loyalty program.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance >18%/an. Plateforme APIs partenaires (airlines, corporate travel, OTAs). Driver structurel #1
kpis.description_fr: B2B = Expedia Partner Solutions (EPS) + Egencia. Fournit technologie & inventaire a airlines, agences, retailers. Tres haute croissance.
kpis.description_en: B2B = Expedia Partner Solutions (EPS) + Egencia. Provides tech & inventory to airlines, agencies, retailers. Very high growth.

kpis.signal: Lodging = 80% du CA. Hotels + alternative accommodations (Vrbo). Driver volume room nights +8% en 2025
kpis.description_fr: Revenu hebergement (hotels + Vrbo/alternative). Segment principal par type service. Room nights stayed +8% en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Lodging revenue (hotels + Vrbo/alternative). Largest service-type segment. Room nights stayed +8% in 2025.

kpis.signal: Forte acceleration 2025 (+23%), EG Advertising +19% et trivago Advertising +33%. Marge elevee
kpis.description_fr: Revenus publicite Expedia Group Advertising (758 M$) + trivago Advertising (417 M$). Service haute marge, croissance soutenue.
kpis.description_en: Expedia Group Advertising ($758M) + trivago Advertising ($417M) revenue. High-margin service, sustained growth.

kpis.signal: Rebond 2025 apres baisse 2024. Metasearch hotelier, segment niche, dependant referrals OTAs concurrents
kpis.description_fr: Revenus tiers trivago (metasearch hotelier). Generes par referrals vers autres OTAs/hoteliers. Segment volatil.
kpis.description_en: trivago third-party revenue (hotel metasearch). Generated by referrals to other OTAs/hotels. Volatile segment.
